title: A fixed time step
description:
Run physics at exactly 60 steps per second whatever the frame rate, and draw smoothly in between.

```
each from a fresh start:
frame dt 0.040 -> 2 physics steps, alpha 0.40
frame dt 0.010 -> 0 steps, alpha 0.60
frame dt 0.500 -> capped at 0.25 -> about 15 steps
```
requirements: An accumulator: add the frame time, run steps of 1/60 while it holds enough, keep the rest.
Cap the frame time at 0.25 s to avoid the "spiral of death".
`alpha = accumulator / step` for drawing between the last two states.
stretch: Show that a ball's path is identical at 30 and 144 frames per second with the fixed step, and not with variable steps.
